# The engine's own run of every recorded block under Satin's rules (`tests/block.rs`, before any
# rerun under a reference's rule): per block, the transactions it included and refused, and the
# digest of the run, the keccak of each transaction's `status` and `gas_used`, the block counters
# row and the post-state row, rendered as JSON with sorted keys. The block gate holds each block's
# run to its line here and prints
# `GATE block-satin blocks=<b> included=<i> refused=<r> pinned=<b> digests=<b> differ=0`; a block
# whose run differs (`BLOCK-SATIN DIFFER`, `BLOCK-SATIN DIGEST`), or that has no line or no digest,
# fails the gate. These are the engine's figures, which no rerun under the reference's rules
# checks: a change of them must be explained by the change that moved them. To take new figures,

# `BLOCK-SATIN UNPINNED <block> included=<i> refused=<r> digest=<d>` lines (without the prefix).
